acceptanceCriteria: JUnit testcases are parsed with a bound and matched to JSON examples by file:line
A count or status mismatch yields a typed infrastructure reason, covered by a fixture
body: PR #1135 (LPCV-V0-090) digests the RspecJunitFormatter output but never parses it, so JUnit and JSON results cannot be cross-checked (e.g. a JSON formatter that drops examples). Expected: parse JUnit testcases, compare counts and statuses with the JSON examples, and report a disagreement as an infrastructure reason.
title: Ruby test provider retains only a sha256 of the JUnit report instead of parsing and cross-checking it (residual of PR #1135)
